newsitem.title: THAILAND: United Finance clarifies weak earnings.
newsitem.headline: United Finance clarifies weak earnings.

text.p: United Finance Corp Plc on Tuesday attributed its big half-year loss to Thailand's bearish financial and equities markets.

United Finance said in a filing to the Stock Exchange of Thailand that its 448.0 million baht net loss in the first half-year, against a 60.2 million baht profit a year ago, was partly due to a 85.6 percent decline in interest and dividend receivables.

The company said under a central bank instruction for finance firms to set aside a 20 percent reserve for sub-standard assets, it increased its reserve for doubtful loans by 197.2 million baht during the period. It did not elaborate.

United Finance said its performance was also hurt by the battered Thai bourse which contributed to a 143.3 million baht loss for its equity investment portfolio. It said the figure included a 121.5 million baht reserve for an unrealised loss of depreciated equities.
